summary: Backend testing of iteration_52 enhancements to DELETE + regenerate flow in retailer_portal.py. Wrote a fresh pytest suite (5 tests) covering all 6 features listed by main agent. All 5 tests PASSED against the live preview API. Tests use MongoDB seed data with _test_marker='TEST_regen_audit' and TEST-INV-/TEST-CN- prefixed numbers; module-scoped teardown cleans up retailer_invoices, retailer_credit_notes, retailer_payments, and deleted_invoices_audit — no production data mutated.

minor.issue: deleted_invoices_audit lookup uses {deleted_invoice_number, retailer_id} and sort by deleted_at DESC — if the same invoice number gets deleted/regenerated multiple times, only the most recent audit is used. Older CN adjustments are effectively lost. Consider linking audit to the specific invoice_id being regenerated when possible.

Old invoice is deleted (line 5705) BEFORE the new invoice document is constructed and inserted (line 5978). No transaction / rollback — any exception in between loses the invoice. Recommend snapshot+restore or Mongo txn.

Orphaned-payment lookup {needs_relinking:true, original_invoice_number, retailer_id} does not scope by invoice_date — if the retailer has two deleted invoices sharing a number (edge case) all matching payments will be relinked into whichever invoice is regenerated first.

action_items: None blocking. Consider (a) scoping audit lookup by invoice_id when audit records reference the source id, (b) wrapping regenerate in a MongoDB transaction so a mid-flow exception cannot lose the invoice, (c) indexing deleted_invoices_audit on (deleted_invoice_number, retailer_id, deleted_at) for O(log n) lookup at scale.
critical_code_review_comments: regenerate_retailer_invoice remains ~450 lines — recommend splitting into capture_state / delete_original / build_new_doc / reapply_cns / relink_payments helpers.
CN reset logic in delete_retailer_invoice (lines 5464-5520) and regenerate_retailer_invoice (lines 5655-5702) is ~60 lines of duplicated code. Extract reset_credit_notes(...) helper.
Delete-then-insert in regenerate is not transactional — the invoice is dropped from Mongo before the new one is built. If build_new_invoice_doc raises (e.g. dispatch fetch fails), data is lost.
retailer_portal.py is 11641 lines — far above the 700-line guideline. Should be split into invoices/payments/credit_notes/dispatches/regeneration submodules.

Response field name inconsistency: DELETE returns 'payments_unlinked' (count) while audit stores both 'payments_unlinked' (count) and 'payment_ids_unlinked' (list). Consider renaming the list to 'payment_ids_unlinked' consistently and dropping the redundant count-with-similar-name.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral. Each test inserts synthetic invoice/payment/CN docs tagged _test_marker='TEST_regen_audit' with TEST-INV-/TEST-CN- number prefixes. Module-scoped autouse fixture cleans up all four affected collections at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_52 features verified: (1) DELETE stores payment_ids_unlinked list in deleted_invoices_audit, (2) regenerate finds orphan payments via needs_relinking + original_invoice_number + retailer_id keys, (3) regenerate clears needs_relinking + original_invoice_number + unlinked_at via $unset on relink, (4) regenerate pulls credit_note_adjustments from audit record when it exists (survives delete) — verified by creating a new invoice with empty CN list and confirming regen populated it from audit, (5) response includes used_audit_record boolean (True when audit found, False when not), (6) GET /orphans returns needs_relinking_count == len(needs_relinking). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_regenerate_audit_orphan_relink.py.
rca of the issue: n/a — all features working as designed.
